drawdown_definition: Equal original notional realized net bps: group equal outcome_available timestamps, fsum each cohort, chronological cumulative equity; max peak minus equity. No account or open mark-to-market curve.
limitations: Already seen historical development, not fresh.
Realized bps DD is not account percentage or mark-to-market drawdown.
Unresolved positions receive no hypothetical terminal PnL.
Observed unmatched winner contribution is zero accounting credit, not a counterfactual loss.
Independent arithmetic does not certify raw-data truth or source-model profitability.
method: Python standard library only; no project imports; no replay or signal generation; actual entry/final/partial fill reconstruction; frozen symbol costs; equal-original-notional realized outcome-cohort drawdown; exact and causal-origin observed attribution.

identical_entry_stream_check.statement: Every other emitted field, including timestamp, side, initial stop, 36-bar hold, compression origin and reclaim level, is exactly identical.

review_scope: Arithmetic and saved evidence binding PASS only; not strategy PASS or promotion.
streak_definition: Sort outcome_available_ts_ms, exit_ts_ms, symbol, identity, signal_ts_ms; net<0 extends streak and net>=0 resets.
verification_note: An initial audit-script assumption grouped month by entry timestamp. Corrected only the independent audit script to documented outcome-month metric semantics; frozen rules, ledgers, reports and results were unchanged.
